risks.title: Pressure on recycled commodity prices
risks.score_rationale: Risk is mentioned in the context of recycling revenues, with recycled commodity prices declining from $164 to $135 per tonne in 2025. Language indicates significant volatility due to market demand, and a direct impact of $13M per $10 per tonne variation on earnings. Technology category as it relates to material flows and associated markets.

risks.title: Reduction in collection activity volume
risks.score_rationale: Volume declined 0.6% in 2025, notably in residential collection and roll-off, due to contract losses and slowdowns in construction. Text emphasizes recurring impacts related to weather and economic conditions. Central position in organic growth analysis.

risks.title: Disruptions related to union activities
risks.score_rationale: Impact of $56M in 2025 is noted, of which $40M in operating costs and $16M in customer discounts. Risk is new in financial adjustments and marked by strong language (isolated but costly activities). People category due to link with workforce and union relations management.

risks.title: Dependence on municipal contracts
risks.score_rationale: Contracts with municipalities are highlighted as the foundation of residential operations, with contract losses cited as a cause of volume decline. Risk is recurring but not aggravated versus prior year. Competition category as it relates to competitive pressure on bid awards.

risks.title: Rising labor costs
risks.score_rationale: Labor costs are increasing due to annual increases and acquisition-driven growth. The line item represents 19.9% of operating costs, up versus 2024. Language is factual but impact recurs across multiple line items (workforce, maintenance). Capital category as it relates to labor costs and cost structure.

risks.title: Risks related to collective pension plans
risks.score_rationale: Withdrawal from a multiemployer pension fund generated a cost of $1M. Text specifies that withdrawal estimates may change with available information. Regulatory risk related to pension obligations and liability volatility.

ai_positioning.summary: RSG does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its annual report. The data provided focuses on the company's financial and operational aspects, without reference to AI or related technology.
